obligations.description: The only clock is clock. A rising edge with reset=1 discards any packet ownership and returns to unlocked arbitration, taking priority over an otherwise accepted beat. Reset is active high and synchronous: changing reset between rising edges does not itself alter ownership. Outputs remain combinational during reset and are not forced low. Apply at least one reset edge before observing specified behavior; power-up state before that edge is unspecified.
obligations.setup: Initialize with a reset edge, then establish either unlocked, input1-owned or input4-owned history as required. No internal state access.
obligations.stimulus: After acquiring each owner in turn using a valid ready accepted nonlast beat, assert reset across a rising edge with both valids and ready high. Also pulse reset between edges and clear before the next edge while each owner is active. Include reset with no ownership.
obligations.expected: The only clock is clock. A rising edge with reset=1 discards any packet ownership and returns to unlocked arbitration, taking priority over an otherwise accepted beat. Reset is active high and synchronous: changing reset between rising edges does not itself alter ownership. Outputs remain combinational during reset and are not forced low. Apply at least one reset edge before observing specified behavior; power-up state before that edge is unspecified.
obligations.sampling: Observe settled combinational outputs before the accepting edge and again after sequential state updates. A between-edge reset pulse must be sampled before the next clock edge to distinguish synchronous reset.
obligations.checker: Use an independent predictor from input history with separate actual/expected signals and explicit mismatch failure; valid-only guarding cannot cover invalid-cycle outputs specified by R005.

obligations.description: When no packet owns the arbiter, input 1 is selected whenever io_in_1_valid=1; otherwise input 4 is selected, including when both valids are zero. Thus input 1 wins simultaneous requests. io_out_valid equals the selected input valid, independently of io_out_ready. The selected input ready equals io_out_ready and the other ready is zero, even when the selected valid is zero. Selection and ready/valid respond combinationally with no registered data latency.

obligations.description: A beat is accepted at a rising edge exactly when io_out_ready and the selected input valid are both one. An accepted beat whose selected last bit is zero grants or retains packet ownership for that input. An accepted beat whose last bit is one releases ownership after that edge, allowing unlocked priority selection immediately thereafter. The beat being accepted uses the ownership and selection that existed before the edge. A one-beat packet does not leave ownership active.

obligations.description: Without an accepted beat, ownership does not change, regardless of either last bit. While owned, the same input stays selected even if its valid becomes zero or the competing input becomes valid. A paused owner therefore yields io_out_valid=0, while its ready still follows io_out_ready and the competing ready stays zero. Backpressure io_out_ready=0 forces both ready outputs low and cannot acquire, release, or switch ownership. Payload is not buffered by this module; current selected input fields remain the source of the combinational outputs.

R-p8-hpa-001.definition: Reset edge while unlocked and while each input owns a packet.
Reset coincident with a valid ready accepted beat, establishing reset priority.
Short reset pulses entirely between rising edges during each ownership history.

R-p8-hpa-002.definition: All four valid combinations including both invalid and both valid.
Each valid combination crossed with downstream ready zero and one.
Inputs change between edges with distinct channel payloads, exposing combinational selection.

R-p8-hpa-003.definition: Independently establish unlocked, input1-owned and input4-owned legal histories.
In each history cross selected valid, downstream ready and selected last, including accepted last and nonlast.
After acceptance observe both contenders to distinguish immediate release from retained ownership and one-beat packets.

R-p8-hpa-004.definition: Each owner pauses valid while the competitor requests, with both last values.
Each owner faces downstream backpressure with last toggling and competing valid.
Resume the same owner, accept its terminal beat, and observe the released selection.

R-p8-hpa-005.definition: Select both channels under unlocked arbitration and packet ownership.
Vary every declared payload field and address through zero, all ones and independent random full-width values.
Observe routed payload and channel constants during valid, invalid and stalled cycles.
